caption.text:
Soooo, anybody want a Joe & Alx relic?😍🚌

We started discussing the possibility of selling my first Skoolie, which the thought of initially makes me wanna bawl but also I’d much rather have someone in it and starting their move to freedom than have it just sitting

This bus has so much of our story wrapped in it. Joe’s second solar system he built. The place where we grew much of our media base doing lives during the build. The “excuse” Joe uses as the initial reason we moved in together😂 

The initial plan was to drive this thing to the tree retreat in Tennessee and use it as the host house but things have shifted in life and now Reality in Costa Rica is the focus🇨🇷

Blood, sweat, tears and a whooooooole lotta love went into this thing and we learned and grew and then went onto build another🚎

I’m gonna miss it but cannot wait to see new life in it #skoolie #buslife #joefelz #joeandalx #felzmedia

caption.text: Most people don’t hit their limit because they can’t do more- they hit it because they never learned how to think beyond where they are. There’s a ceiling to every life. Income. Freedom. Options. Not because it’s fixed, but because most people never learn how to break the one society has ingrained in us. Once you do- it’s hard to unsee. You start realizing the life that you thought was “out there” is within reach. Not easy. Not automatic. Just…available🚐🇨🇷☀️ #Mindset #matrix #escape #buildingreality #joefelz

I am fully confident my trailer park days of using butter knives as screwdrivers prepared me to build things in Costa Rica😂 

You gotta think outside the box here, use items you normally wouldn’t, repurpose, and just go with the flow. 

Had a few last-minute adjustments since the baby chickens started escaping out of the holes but everything is finished today just in time for us to head back to the states! 

These two are my favorite babies- they both had pretty terrible births and I was relatively certain they would join the multiple others we had lost already- but they made it and they’re the most beautiful unique babies we have! Meet Hershey and Hoot🐣👩‍🌾🇨🇷 #homesteading #joeandalx #expatlife #chickencoop #diy
